chunks: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The completion of the visitation is that you place your hand upon the patient when you go to him.

key_terms.الْعِيَادَة: 'Iyada — the Islamic practice of visiting the sick; a recommended act (mustahabb) in Islamic law
key_terms.تَمَام: Completion, perfection — reaching the full measure of an act

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the completion of visiting the sick?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that the full etiquette of visiting the sick requires a physical gesture of care — placing one's hand upon the patient. This sunnah of 'iyada (sick-visitation) was well-established in early Islamic practice; the Imam's teaching emphasizes that merely appearing at a sick person's side is not sufficient, but that a compassionate physical touch completes the act. This would have resonated with an audience familiar with the broader hadith literature on 'iyada as a communal obligation.
